header.intro: Case studies from Hnry. The work is confidential fintech, so the visuals are diagrams and interface fragments rather than screenshots.

case_studies.title: Card Issuing, End to End
case_studies.headline: Replacing an incumbent banking and card provider from API client to the card in the customer's hand.
case_studies.description: SOAP provisioning chain in the payments gem, virtual card issuing, real-time card transaction processing, a settlement reconciliation pipeline (SFTP retrieval, PGP decryption, per-transaction processing), and automated compliance reporting.

case_studies.title: Identity Verification in Three Countries
case_studies.headline: One identity verification rollout across the UK, Australia and New Zealand.
case_studies.description: Backend integration, decision and ongoing-monitoring webhooks, customer flow, and admin tooling, wired into two separate onboarding implementations (a React tour and a legacy server-rendered flow). Closed compliance gaps found during rollout.

case_studies.title: UK Self Assessment Tax Return
case_studies.headline: A full-stack tax return, designed to be reused across jurisdictions.
case_studies.description: Data model using single-table inheritance, a polymorphic filing-obligation link and full auditing. A React Hook Form wizard with seven independently toggled sections, a stage stepper, save-and-continue vs submit, and an admin review side with a reusable notes API. HMRC API client gem with per-request OAuth and fraud-prevention headers.

case_studies.title: AI Engineering & Developer Tooling
case_studies.headline: Getting practical value out of AI across engineering, operations and marketing.
case_studies.description: Four internal developer plugins covering on-call triage, the coding-task lifecycle (intake → planning → per-commit lint and spec gating → pre-PR validation) and coding-style resolution, designed to be squad-agnostic through shared configuration.
